messages:
Maria C: NetBridge cutover tomorrow — quick alignment on observability & KMS key rotation. on track?
Sam P: We're green on VPC peering and firewall rules; need KMS key alias confirm from security.
Monica S: KMS key created, waiting for IAM role to be allowed.
Liam I: IAM role request sent to NetBridge (ticket #NB-112); they need project number. Maria, can you share?
Maria C: shared project ID in email; pasted here: proj-netbridge-93. Also audit log sink needs syslog endpoint — what's the address?
Sam P: Ops asked to send to splunk-collector.netbridge.prod:2514. Will add TLS.
Monica S: Confirmed key rotation window — prefer 02:00 UTC; will schedule. Also note retention policy 365d.
Liam I: Quick test script for connectivity:
```bash
nc -vz splunk-collector.netbridge.prod 2514
```
Maria C: ran it, shows connection timed out. Liam can you check from our egress nat?
Liam I: looks like route missing on their side. Reached out to netbridge-netops — pinging them now. @Nila (Eng) FYI on the retry/backoff config in runtime?
Nila (Eng): Our SDK default retry is 3x with 500ms base. For cutover we recommend 5x with jitter to avoid bursts.
deploy-bot: Dry-run cutover scheduled at 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z — status: pending
Maria C: Action items: (1) NetBridge to confirm route + firewall for 2514 (owner: NetBridge) (2) Monica to finalize KMS rotation window (owner: Monica) (3) Liam to validate from our NAT once route fixed (owner: Liam) (4) Sam to update runbook with Splunk endpoint tls settings (owner: Sam). Also flag renewal risk: if cutover slips by >2 weeks, renewal QBR gets impacted.
Sam P: noted. I'll add renewal flag to account tracker and loop in AM.
Monica S: ACK. I'll sign rotation once NetBridge confirms route. Tentative 02:00 UTC ok.
Maria C: thanks. Please drop confirmations here. :thumbsup:
Sam P: +1
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled in 12h for cutover run-through.
